subject: Per-customer model pinning & region routing — TruBank enterprise ask
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Per-customer model pinning & region routing — TruBank enterprise ask

Team —

Quick context: TruBank (large US regional bank) is in final legal/procurement review for a multi-year contract (deal id RWD-TRU-2026-045). Their security and architecture teams have one blocking technical ask before signing: the ability to pin production traffic for specific customers to a designated model variant and ensure routing into a US-only region (data residency + dedicated model selection).

Specific asks from the customer (see attached TruBank_MA_Platform_Reqs.pdf):
- Per-tenant model pinning: ability to lock a customer to an exact model version (and a fallback variant) independent of global rollout.
- Region routing: enforce routing to US-hosted instances (cannot fall back to EU/APAC).
- Audit trail: show model version used per request for 30 days (simple logs are acceptable).

They told procurement they need technical confirmation this is possible and an estimated timeline. They are comfortable with an implementation that is scoped as an "enterprise exception" tied to Dedicated/Private deployments if needed. Procurement also asked for any marginal costs upfront — pricing_term_sheet_v2.docx attached.

As the AE on the deal, I need to know: is this something Product/Engineering can commit to shipping within Q3 (target: Aug 31) if we prioritize? What is the estimated effort (S/M/L) and any obvious blockers?

Also copying Steph for CS concerns (onboarding & config) and Aisha for leadership visibility.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Per-customer model pinning & region routing — TruBank enterprise ask

Thanks for the heads up, Karthik. Appreciate the clear summary and attachments. I pulled the TruBank doc and skimmed the asks. High-level reactions:

- Per-tenant model pinning: we have a partial primitive today (model version pinning at deployment + canary routing) but we don't have a first-class per-tenant pinning API that persists across global rollouts. Likely requires changes to routing policy layer + tenant metadata and a simple UI/API to assign pin.
- Region-only routing: we support region affinity policies but there are edge cases where fallback to another region can occur under capacity pressure. Making strict region hard-affinity (no cross-region fallback) is more of an orchestration constraint + capacity/SLAs conversation.
- Audit trail: should be straightforward — our tracing already includes model id for most requests; we need a retention/aggregation change to meet their 30-day requirement and exportability.

I'll need an engineering estimate. I asked EngInfra to review and attached an initial impact matrix (eng-impact-matrix.xlsx) for visibility — it's a draft.

Questions for you / TruBank:
1) Are they asking for per-customer pinning to be configurable via API/Console, or is config-as-code (we add config on your behalf) acceptable for an initial rollout?
2) Is the US-only enforcement required for all environments (dev/staging/prod) or only prod traffic?

If procurement needs a formal statement, we can provide a conditional commitment: "We will prioritize a per-customer pinning + US-hard-affinity implementation for TruBank on Redwood Dedicated with an estimated delivery window of X if customer signs by Y and accepts the dedicated capacity pricing addendum." But I need scope and effort first.

-Marissa
Director, Product Management | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Per-customer model pinning & region routing — TruBank enterprise ask

Looping in CS perspective. A few operational notes from onboarding/ops side:

- If we do per-tenant pinning as a console/API feature, CS will need a runbook for pin assignment, rollback, and validation; ideally a test harness so we can validate pin behavior pre-prod.
- US-only routing: we will need a verification step and periodic checks (we can add health checks but also need a reporting mechanism showing where traffic was served from). This ties back to the audit trail request.
- Migration risk: If TruBank is pinned to an older model for a security patch or critical fix, we need a defined path for emergency unpin + forced rollout. That should be in the MAP (mutual action plan).

From a timeline perspective, if Eng estimates size L, CS will need 4 weeks for runbooks, test harness, and customer validation after Eng ships. If size M, we can compress to 2 weeks.

-Steph
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@trubank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Choi <alan.choi@trubank.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Per-customer model pinning & region routing — TruBank enterprise ask

Karthik —

Thanks for flagging internally. Quick clarifications from TruBank:
- Per-customer pinning must be configurable by our security team through the console (we won't expect Redwood to hand-edit configs each time). An API is preferred.
- US enforcement is required for prod only; we can accept cross-region routing in non-prod.
- Audit trail: CSV export of model version per request (request id, timestamp, model id, region) for 30 days is sufficient.

We are on a tight procurement timeline and need confirmation within 10 business days to keep the procurement window. Happy to jump on a technical call if it helps.

Best,
Sarah Lane
VP, Platforms & Architecture | TruBank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Per-customer model pinning & region routing — TruBank enterprise ask

Update from EngInfra after quick triage (summary of Slack thread, see ENGINF-1123 linked):

- Rough sizing: this breaks into three workstreams: routing policy hard-affinity (M), per-tenant pinning API/console (M-L), audit/log retention + export (S). Overall cross-team estimate: Medium (approx 6-8 sprints across a stretched team) but can be prioritized to land a minimal viable delivery for TruBank in ~10 weeks if we reallocate some sprint capacity and tag it as a paid enterprise sprint.
- Key blockers: capacity gating (strict US-only hard affinity requires dedicated capacity or strong SLA guarantees), migration & rollback tooling, and UI/console work for pin assignments.
- Proposed mitigation: offer TruBank a Dedicated deployment with a short-term workaround: manual config pinning + guaranteed US-only capacity during onboarding and until per-tenant API ships. This would reduce initial scope and satisfy procurement short-term.

Next asks for Sales/CS:
1) Confirm whether customer is willing to accept the Dedicated + manual config workaround for initial sign, and whether they're willing to accept a specified delivery timeline (we can propose 10 weeks post-sign).
2) If yes, confirm commercial terms for a two-month dedicated capacity commitment (we'll need legal & finance to attach the pricing addendum).

I can draft a conditional technical statement for procurement language once we have confirmation on the mitigation path.

-Marissa
Director, Product Management | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Per-customer model pinning & region routing — TruBank enterprise ask

Thanks everyone — solid notes. Quick summary & proposed MAP to share with TruBank: 

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- Immediate: Offer TruBank a Dedicated deployment with guaranteed US-only capacity and manual config-based model pinning for initial onboarding. (Sales/Finance: confirm 2-month dedicated capacity pricing addendum)
- Within 10 weeks post-sign: Ship per-tenant pinning API + Console UI (M-L) and strict prod-only region hard-affinity routing; deliver audit export (CSV) for 30-day retention. (Product/Eng: target 10 weeks if prioritized)
- CS: deliver runbooks, test harness, and validation plan 2 weeks after Eng cuts the release.

Action items: 
- Karthik: Confirm with TruBank that Dedicated + manual config is acceptable as an initial path (I will call Sarah today).
- Sales/Finance: prepare pricing addendum for 2 months dedicated (refer pricing_term_sheet_v2.docx).
- Marissa/Eng: please estimate a firm sprint plan (which teams, blockers) by next Tue so I can include it in procurement response.
- Steph: draft validation & rollback runbook template we can reuse across enterprise exceptions.

I'll send a concise note to TruBank summarizing the above once we confirm the commercial side. If anyone wants to join the call with Sarah, I'm scheduling it for Monday afternoon PST.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
